info.title: Capital events API
info.description: Capital calls, subsequent closings with equalisation, distributions through a European waterfall, feeder pass-through, side letters and MFN, with a double-entry ledger, ISO 20022 payments and a hash-chained audit trail. Money is integer cents in strings. Every result is approved by a second person against its hash before notices go out.
